title: Fried eggs
summary: Crispy edges, runny yolk, about 5 minutes.
source: Written for REMY by Claude, timers from cook-times.json (eggs). Waiting for Matthew's review.
notes: Runny yolks are a personal choice. For anyone vulnerable (pregnant, elderly, very young, unwell), cook until yolk and white are firm: see food-safety.json. For a firm yolk, cover the pan for the last minute or flip the egg ('over hard').
ingredients: Pinch of salt and black pepper

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in the frying pan on medium heat.
looks_right: oil shimmering, moving easily when the pan is tilted
looks_wrong: oil smoking (too hot: take the pan off for a moment)

steps.instruction: Crack each egg into a small bowl first, then slide it gently into the pan.
looks_right: the white turning opaque at the edges straight away
looks_wrong: shell in the egg (scoop it out with a bigger bit of shell)
white spitting and browning fast (heat too high)
steps.done_when: The white is fully set with no clear, jelly-like bits near the yolk, and the edges are lightly golden.

steps.instruction: Season, then lift the eggs out with the spatula and serve straight away.
looks_wrong: clear, runny white around the yolk (needs another minute)
